'''The Package''' was an object of great value to [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]], it was given as a gift to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==History==
Two [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] squads were assigned the dangerous task of retrieving the package intended for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Dispatched to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], a [[Sarge's clone commando squad (Ord Mantell)|squad]] led by [[Sarge (clone commando)|Sarge]] and [[Unidentified clone commando squad (Ord Mantell)|another squad]] attempted to intercept a gang of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] transporting it.

The Trandoshans killed the latter squad and were pursued by the former to a meeting with [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces. The ill-fated squad was whittled down to just its leader, who tackled and executed the lead Trandoshan with his [[Knife/Legends|combat knife]].

Upon receipt of the package, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] privately revealed that it was a worthless trinket and had it stored with his other gifts.
